{{Short description|Bulgarian mountaineer (1978–2021)}} {{Use dmy dates|date=February 2021}} {{Family name hatnote|Georgiev|Skatov|lang=Bulgarian}}{{Infobox person | name = | image = Atanas Skatov, Makalu Summit.jpg | caption = Skatov, 23 May 2016, Summit Makalu, 8485m | native_name = Атанас Георгиев Скатов | native_name_lang = bl | birth_name = Atanas Georgiev Skatov | birth_date = {{birth date|1978|03|11|df=yes}} | birth_place = [[Sliven]], [[Bulgaria]] | death_date = {{death date and age|2021|02|05|1978|03|11|df=yes}} | death_place = [[K2]], [[Pakistan]] | death_cause = Mountaineering fall | alma_mater = Humboldt University, Berlin | occupation = Agricultural scientist | years_active = 2012–2021 | known_for = {{Hlist |Veganism | Mountaineering}} | title = | children = 1 | awards = 2019 Green Person of Bulgaria | website = {{URL|atanasskatov.com/}} }} '''Atanas Georgiev Skatov''' ({{Langx|bg|Атанас Георгиев Скатов}}; 11 March 1978 – 5 February 2021) was a Bulgarian [[Mountaineering|mountaineer]], [[Veganism|vegan]] and [[agronomist]] in plant protection. == Biography == Skatov was born in [[Sliven]], [[Bulgaria]]. In 2001, he graduated from the [[Agricultural University of Plovdiv]] and held a master's degree in plant protection. He later earned a doctorate from Humboldt University in Berlin and worked as a scientist.{{Cite web |last=Skatov |first=Atanas |title=About me |url=https://atanasskatov.com/about-me-en/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Atanas Skatov |language=en-GB}}{{Cite web |last=Nestler |first=Stefan |date=2020-12-02 |title=Atanas Skatov before K2 winter expedition: "The mountain will decide" |url=https://abenteuer-berg.de/en/atanas-skatov-before-k2-winter-expedition-the-mountain-will-decide/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Adventure Mountain |language=en-GB}} Skatov later published scientific articles in Bulgaria and abroad.{{Cite book |last=Dimitrov |first=Atanas Georgiev |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=MIlfhfRhVDUC&q=atanas+georgiev+dimitrov&pg=PA1 |title=Integrierte Produktion von Tomaten (Lycopersicon esculentum Mill.) im Gewächshaus unter besonderer Berücksichtigung der integrierten Bekämpfung der Weissen Fliege (Trialeurodes vaporariorum Westwood) |date=2005 |publisher=Tenea Verlag Ltd. |isbn=978-3-86504-116-6 |language=de}}{{Cite journal |last1=Böhme |first1=Michael H. |last2=Dimitrov-Skatov |first2=Atanas G. |date=2018-12-20 |title=Investigations to biological and organic treatments against pests in vegetable cultivation |journal=IOP Conference Series: Earth and Environmental Science |volume=215 |article-number=012012 |doi=10.1088/1755-1315/215/1/012012 |issn=1755-1315 |doi-access=free}} In the summer of 2010, Skatov discovered his love of the mountains while hiking a mountain trail at home in Bulgaria.{{Cite web |last=Routen |first=Ash |date=2021-02-07 |title=K2: The Fallen Five » Explorersweb |url=https://explorersweb.com/k2-the-fallen-five/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Explorersweb}} It sparked a drive to begin a more active lifestyle. He claimed that he had never been on a mountain until 2010 and had not been an active sports person before 2012.{{Cite news |title=Д-р Скатов по скатовете - Списание Осем |newspaper=Списание Осем |url=https://spisanie8.bg/%D1%80%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8/%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8/2352-%D0%B4%D1%80-%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2-%D0%BF%D0%BE-%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%B5.html |access-date=2017-02-13}} As he began to develop his physical health, he adopted a vegan lifestyle.{{Cite web |last=Benzesh |first=Sheny |date=2022-02-01 |title=A Climber We Lost: Atanas Skatov, February 5 |url=https://www.climbing.com/people/a-climber-we-lost-atanas-skatov/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Climbing |language=en-US}} === Mountaineering === Skatov was self-educated in the subject of climbing and mountaineering, often joining climbing expeditions as an [[Expedition climbing|expedition climber]]. In May 2014, he claimed to have become the first known vegan to ascend [[Mount Everest|Everest]].{{Cite web |last=Mendis |first=Dishan |date=2018-08-16 |title=The Story of Atanas Skatov–First Vegan to Climb Mount Everest |url=https://veganuniversal.com/atanas-skatov-first-vegan-mount-everest |access-date=2020-10-27 |website=Vegan Universal |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |date=March 2016 |title=Meet The First Vegan Ever To Climb Mount Everest (And Conquer The 6 Highest Continental Summits In Record Time) - |url=http://inourishgently.com/first-vegan-on-everest/ |url-status=usurped |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161008142540/http://inourishgently.com/first-vegan-on-everest/ |archive-date=8 October 2016 |access-date=2017-02-13 |website=inourishgently.com |language=en-US}} His attempt was later refuted, as he admitted to having consumed honey.{{Cite web |title=The first vegan to summit Everest |url=https://www.vegansociety.com/news/blog/first-vegan-summit-everest |access-date=2021-02-13 |website=The Vegan Society |language=en}} Skatov would become the first known person on a vegan diet to successfully climb the highest summits on six continents in less than two years, including four [[Eight-thousander|eight – thousanders]] in a week apiece. In 2015, Skatov was awarded an "Honorary Citizen" of Sliven, Bulgaria.{{Cite web |last=Прес |first=Сливен |title=ПЕТИМА ПОЧЕТНИ ГРАЖДАНИ НА СЛИВЕН |url=http://slivenpress.bg/novini-sliven/16481-%D0%9F%D0%95%D0%A2%D0%98%D0%9C%D0%90-%D0%9F%D0%9E%D0%A7%D0%95%D0%A2%D0%9D%D0%98-%D0%93%D0%A0%D0%90%D0%96%D0%94%D0%90%D0%9D%D0%98-%D0%9D%D0%90-%D0%A1%D0%9B%D0%98%D0%92%D0%95%D0%9D |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170214103617/http://slivenpress.bg/novini-sliven/16481-%D0%9F%D0%95%D0%A2%D0%98%D0%9C%D0%90-%D0%9F%D0%9E%D0%A7%D0%95%D0%A2%D0%9D%D0%98-%D0%93%D0%A0%D0%90%D0%96%D0%94%D0%90%D0%9D%D0%98-%D0%9D%D0%90-%D0%A1%D0%9B%D0%98%D0%92%D0%95%D0%9D |archive-date=2017-02-14 |access-date=2017-02-13 |website=slivenpress.bg |language=bg-bg}} In the same year, he also published his first book{{Cite book|title=Богинята Майка на Вселената. Дневникът на един веган|publisher=Кибеа|year=2015|isbn=978-954-474-714-5|location=София}} and released his first documentary movie.{{Cite web|url=https://vimeo.com/151119751|title=The SKATOV experiment|website=Vimeo|access-date=2017-02-13}} In 2017, Skatov ascended Everest from the Nepalese south side. In June 2017, he ascended [[Mount Denali]] in [[Alaska]] becoming the first Bulgarian and the world's first vegan to successfully climb the [[Seven Summits]].{{Cite web |title=Bulgarian Atanas Skatov Climbed the Highest Mounts on Each of the 7 Continents |url=https://www.bnt.bg/en/a/bulgarian-atanas-skatov-climbed-the-highest-mounts-on-each-of-the-7-continents |access-date=2019-10-06 |website=BNT News |language=en}} In 2019, Skatov was awarded the 2019 Green Person of Bulgaria.{{Cite web |title=TEDxVitosha {{!}} TED |url=https://www.ted.com/tedx/events/35565 |access-date=2020-10-27 |website=www.ted.com}} At this time, he was attempting to become the first known vegan to climb the [[Eight-thousander|14 highest peaks]] on Earth, and had reportedly summitted 10 of them.{{Cite web |title=Bulgarian Atanas Skatov Successfully Climbed his 10th Eight-Thousander - Novinite.com - Sofia News Agency |url=https://www.novinite.com/articles/200700/Bulgarian+Atanas+Skatov+Successfully+Climbed+his+10th+Eight-Thousander |access-date=2019-10-05 |website=www.novinite.com}} === Final climb === In 2020, Skatov was planning to climb [[K2]] in his attempt to be the first vegan to climb all eight-thousanders. However, climbing expeditions that year were delayed due to the global [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. In December 2020, Skatov planned a winter ascent despite K2 being one of the world's most challenging and [[List of deaths on eight-thousanders#K2|deadly eight-thousanders]]. The choice of a winter ascent was especially notable as at the time, as the mountain had never been successfully ascended in winter. Skatov was described as a strong and technically competent climber, capable of making a successful winter ascent.{{Cite web |last=Benavides |first=Angela |date=2021-02-09 |title=The Mess on K2: Interview With Antonios Sykaris » Explorersweb |url=https://explorersweb.com/the-mess-on-k2-interview-with-antonios-sykaris/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Explorersweb}} On 16 January 2021, a Nepalese team made the first successful winter ascent of K2.{{Cite news |last=Beaumont |first=Peter |date=2021-01-16 |title=Nepalese team makes first successful winter ascent of K2 |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/jan/16/nepalese-team-makes-first-successful-winter-ascent-of-k2 |access-date=2024-10-22 |work=The Observer |language=en-GB |issn=0029-7712}} Roughly three weeks later, Skatov died on 5 February, aged 42, of a fall while descending from Camp 3 after an unsuccessful ascent.{{cite web |date=5 February 2021 |title=Bulgarian alpinist Skatov dies during K2 expedition |url=https://nation.com.pk/06-Feb-2021/bulgarian-alpinist-skatov-dies-during-k2-expedition |access-date=6 February 2021 |work=The Nation}}{{Cite web |last=Saikaly |first=Elia |date=2021-02-14 |title=Atanas Skatov - What happened on K2? |url=https://eliasaikaly.com/atanas-skatov-what-happened-on-k2/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Elia Saikaly - Adventurer - Filmmaker - Speaker |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |last=Nestler |first=Stefan |date=2021-02-05 |title=Atanas Skatov fell to his death on K2 |url=https://abenteuer-berg.de/en/atanas-skatov-fell-to-his-death-on-k2/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Adventure Mountain |language=en-GB}} Skatov and his sherpa began their descent after spending the night outside as there were not enough tents for the climbers on the mountain. As they began to climb down, other climbers suddenly noticed Skatov's body falling from the mountain. Initial reports cited Skatov's cause of death to be due to a broken safety rope.{{Cite web |title=Обявиха официалната причина за смъртта на Скатов |url=https://www.vesti.bg/sviat/obiaviha-oficialnata-prichina-za-smyrtta-na-skatov-6121270 |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Vesti.bg |language=bg}} These reports were later refuted. His cause of death was later attributed to overexertion.{{Cite web |title=Откриха тялото на Атанас Скатов, не скъсано въже е причината за падането му |url=https://www.vesti.bg/bulgaria/otkriha-tialoto-na-atanas-skatov-ne-skysano-vyzhe-e-prichinata-za-padaneto-mu-6121130 |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Vesti.bg |language=bg}} His body was recovered by a Pakistani military helicopter crew later that day.{{Cite web |title=Откриха тялото на Атанас Скатов (обновено) |url=https://bnr.bg/horizont/post/101416800/helikopter-na-pakistanskata-armia-izdirva-skatov |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=bnr.bg |language=bg}} === Legacy === Upon learning of his death, Bulgarian Prime Minister [[Boyko Borisov]] wrote:
"The mountain took another of our great climbers. Atanas Skatov was a brave man, a man with a cause. I express my condolences to his family and relatives. May his memory be bright!"
Skatov would be one of five climbers to lose their lives on K2 during the Winter 2020 – 21 season.{{Cite web |last=Routen |first=Ash |date=2021-02-07 |title=K2: The Fallen Five » Explorersweb |url=https://explorersweb.com/k2-the-fallen-five/ |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=Explorersweb}} == Mountaineering expeditions == {| class="wikitable" ! extract: Atanas Georgiev Skatov (Bulgarian: Атанас Георгиев Скатов; 11 March 1978 – 5 February 2021) was a Bulgarian mountaineer, vegan and agronomist in plant protection.
